title: Travis Walton abduction two weeks after NBC's The UFO Incident

tellings.quote: not that great. But what happens two weeks after the UFO incident, uh, Travis Walton gets abducted.

plain: In 1975 the television network NBC aired The UFO Incident, a film starring the actor James Earl Jones and based on the book The Interrupted Journey, about a couple's reported abduction, and two weeks later a man named Travis Walton said he was abducted. The screenwriter and producer Bryce Zabel points out the timing to Michels, calling the film "not that great" but noting what came right after it. The point is that a TV film may have shaped, or been followed by, one of the best-known abduction claims.
